modules.title: 同一条规则怎样影响爬虫，却不成为网站的门锁

items.title: 文件位置决定适用范围
items.text: robots.txt 通常放在站点根目录，例如 https://example.com/robots.txt；规则只对对应的协议、主机和端口范围生效。

items.title: 爬虫读取规则后决定是否请求
items.text: 遵守规则的爬虫会根据 User-agent、Allow 和 Disallow 判断路径；普通浏览器不会因为这份文件而自动失去访问能力。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Robots.txt 控制的是爬虫抓取建议，不是权限；它和搜索结果中的 noindex 也不是同一件事。需要保护管理页、订单或客户数据时，应使用认证授权和服务端检查，不能只隐藏链接或写 Disallow。

lessonPractice.title: 管理页包含客户数据，团队想在 robots.txt 里写 Disallow 来保护它。应该怎样判断？

options.label: 用认证和授权保护管理页，再视需要用 robots.txt 减少爬虫抓取
options.feedback: 对。权限系统决定谁能访问数据；robots.txt 只给遵守规则的爬虫抓取建议，不能阻止知道 URL 的人打开页面。

options.label: 只写 Disallow，因为爬虫看不到的路径就不会被任何人访问
options.feedback: Disallow 不是门锁，普通用户和不遵守规则的程序仍可能请求该地址，敏感数据不能依靠它保护。

options.label: 从导航中删除管理页链接，就能替代访问控制
options.feedback: 隐藏链接只减少被发现的机会，不会检查请求者身份，也不能阻止直接访问已知地址。

en.title: An admin page contains customer data, and the team wants to protect it with Disallow in robots.txt. What is the right judgment?

options.label: Protect the admin page with authentication and authorization, then use robots.txt only to reduce crawling if useful
options.feedback: Correct. Permissions decide who can access data; robots.txt is a crawling suggestion for compliant crawlers and cannot block people who know the URL.

options.label: Disallow is enough because a path hidden from crawlers cannot be accessed by anyone
options.feedback: Disallow is not a lock. People and non-compliant programs can still request the URL, so sensitive data cannot rely on it.

options.label: Remove the admin page from navigation instead of adding access control
options.feedback: Hiding a link only reduces discovery. It does not check identity or prevent direct access to a known URL.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请在站点根目录生成 robots.txt，只限制重复筛选路径的抓取，保留正常商品页；检查文件位置、规则匹配和普通浏览器仍可访问。管理页和客户数据必须另用认证授权，不要用 Disallow 代替权限。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Create robots.txt at the site root to limit crawling of duplicate filter paths while keeping normal product pages crawlable. Check the file location, rule matches, and that a normal browser can still access the path. Protect admin pages and customer data with authentication and authorization, not Disallow.

references.title: Google 如何解释 robots.txt 规范
references.title_en: How Google interprets the robots.txt specification

learning.assumes: You know that search crawlers visit public sites and have seen paths that should not be crawled frequently.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether a robots.txt rule affects crawling or user access, and know that sensitive pages need authentication and authorization.

modules.title: How one rule affects crawlers without becoming a site lock

items.title: The file location sets its scope
items.text: robots.txt normally lives at the site root, such as https://example.com/robots.txt. Rules apply to the matching protocol, host, and port.

items.title: A crawler reads the rules before requesting
items.text: A compliant crawler uses User-agent, Allow, and Disallow to decide whether to request a path. A normal browser does not lose access because of this file.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Robots.txt is a crawling instruction, not permission control, and it is not the same as noindex in search results. Protect admin pages, orders, and customer data with authentication, authorization, and server-side checks rather than links hidden from navigation or Disallow alone.
